title: Arrow tool captions: legible pill labels like the measure tool
notes: Objective: measure-redline > epic-uehjr1 (user epic: using the arrow tool to point to something should make it easy to create a legible caption in a pill with a shadow, similar to the measure tool). Next release. When the user points at something with the arrow tool, offer a caption rendered as a pill with a shadow, matching the legibility treatment the measure tool captions ship with, so redline callouts read cleanly over any screenshot. Start from the measure caption styling (docs/design/next-measure.md) for visual consistency; keep it non-destructive (styling applied at render time). Open a UX decision if caption entry/placement behavior is ambiguous beyond what the epic sentence settles.
